card.name: Partway through longer words
card.fires_on: A middle piece of a longer word that is split up, such as flo-pp-y, ENCEPH-AL-OPATHY, barbit-ur-ates or EMBRY-O-FETAL. It fires before the rest of the word is finished.

modes.label: Medical terms in warnings
modes.description: Middle piece of a long capitalised medical term in a boxed warning heading.

modes.label: Ordinary split words
modes.description: Middle piece of a general word or brand name split into parts.
modes.example: flo<<pp>>iness rather than muscle twitching, soon

card.plain: It lights up in the middle of long or unusual words that are split into pieces, especially in warning headings.
